integrity.computational_evidence: Included executable standard-library checker exhaustively verifies all four-site cuts, all binary cuts, and determinant bounds.
integrity.proof_scope: The fixed finite graph pair; exact minor bounds plus field-uniform inference for every odd prime.

scientific_limitations: Only the two explicitly defined sixteen-vertex simple graphs and their unit-weight graph states are included.
Local dimensions are primes; composite dimensions and weighted or mixed states are not treated.
The comparison is local-unitary with arbitrary permutations, not entangling-gate convertibility.
Historical priority remains subject to independent inspection of specialized graph-state orbit literature.
title: Characteristic-selective equivalence of Shrikhande and rook graph states
